daily_narrative.happened: Equities bounced, with the S&P 500 up 0.6% and Nasdaq up 0.8%, while the move appears to reflect a calmer tape after a sharp volatility spike, led by technology and cyclicals and marked by weakness in several high-multiple names.[1] In a transition regime, the 1M factor mix favoring value over growth alongside the stronger industrials/materials bid suggests rotation toward cheaper, more cyclically exposed exposure rather than durable growth leadership.[1]
